text:
alex_cole: Heads-up — I'm starting an ARM64 reference templates effort for cloud marketplace delivery. Goal: provide a slim Terraform module + marketplace YAML that partners can drop into their repo. Will share a draft artifact in this thread. Ping @maria_singh @jordan_le for infra/module review.

maria_singh: Awesome — can you include a CI matrix for Graviton3 and a GCP Tau instance type? Also please make sure input var names follow our marketplace contract (region, image_id, license).

jordan_le: Quick note: avoid pinning provider versions in the module root, instead pin in the example/consumer terraform. Also include a minimal example usage and a `outputs.tf` that exposes the marketplace deployable URL.

samir_khan: From partner engineering: they'd like a "one-click" option if possible (marketplace YAML + small terraform wrapper). If we provide a tiny wrapper that calls the module and a hosted example, adoption will be easier.

alex_cole: Uploaded a first-pass snippet and a manifest idea. Short snippets below: 

```hcl
# examples/simple/main.tf
module "redwood_arm_marketplace" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates.git//modules/arm64-marketplace"
  region = var.region
  image_id = var.image_id
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}
```

```yaml
# marketplace/manifest.yaml
name: redwood-arm64-reference
description: Minimal ARM64 reference deploy for marketplace publishing
resources:
  - type: terraform
    path: examples/simple
```

devrel_bot: Draft artifact uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/partner-templates/arm64-reference-v0.1.tar.gz :rocket:

lisa_ops: FYI — add KMS notes for private deployments and a short section on customer-managed keys (CMKs). We need to call out required KMS IAM roles so enterprise partners can validate in advance.

alex_cole: Thanks all — I've pushed an update with CI matrix and KMS section. @samir_khan can you give a partner-side thumbs up by EOD Friday? If yes we'll open PR in the partner repo and schedule a short demo.

samir_khan: I'll review today and post feedback. Initial reaction: clean, thanks for keeping example tiny. A couple of asks: 1) add a smoke test `terraform apply` CI job that runs under an ephemeral account, 2) include an `outputs.marketplace_link` output for easy verification.

alex_cole: On it — will add smoke test and output. Plan: internal sign-off next Wed, then partner PR the week after. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
